articles.title: Donald Trump claims ‘Iran war will end very soon’ as midterm rallies heat up – US politics live
articles.summary:
The US president said that the war will end ‘as soon as I want it to end’ as the midterms take place under a cloud of economic uncertainty

  • Sign up for the Breaking News US email to get newsletter alerts in your inbox

US president Donald Trump claimed the Iran war ‘will end very soon,’ as voters consider their options ahead of midterm elections that are taking place amid economic uncertainty and ongoing global conflict.

Speaking to reporters on Wednesday evening, Trump said: “The Iran war will end very soon. It’s going to end very soon, as soon as I want it to end, it’ll end.” He added that Iran would “never have a nuclear weapon” and that oil prices would “drop like a rock”.

James Talarico, the Texas Democratic nominee for Senate, faced a grilling from undecided voters on a range of issues from Gaza to his faith at a town hall. Something he emphasized was his aspiration to put residents above party allegiance.

Ukraine’s president Volodymyr Zelenskyy said he felt ‘betrayed’ by the US after Ukraine’s military access to Elon Musk’s Starlink satellite was restricted. The US president has denied that the administration has cut intelligence sharing but Musk suggested on X that the US government was behind the restrictions.

Trump’s new press secretary Katie Zacharia is facing scrutiny over her claims that she’s a lawyer. Zacharia has clarified some of the questions but the big one remains: has she ever passed the bar?

Continue reading...

articles.title: US officials considering ad campaign to urge South African Afrikaners to emigrate
articles.summary:
Exclusive: Trump has falsely claimed Afrikaners are facing ‘white genocide’, but very few have applied to live in US

The US government could spend hundreds of thousands of dollars on a media campaign in South Africa to figure out why more white Afrikaners are not applying to become refugees to the US, as Donald Trump had hoped.

State department officials, according to an August proposal seen by the Guardian, outlined a roughly $335,000 research and advertising effort after applications to the refugee program “trended lower than expected” since Afrikaners were allowed to apply directly online in November 2025. The document, written by the US mission in South Africa with a department research unit for the embassy in Pretoria, admits officials know little about why.

archive.security_status_cs: Americké trhy a politickou scénu otřásá prudký výprodej v technologickém sektoru vyvolaný čínským modelem DeepSeek a rostoucí geopolitické napětí ohledně obchodních dohod a války na Blízkém východě. Administrativa prezidenta Trumpa čelí vnitřním sporům kvůli kontroverzním krokům, jako je dovoz ruské nafty či restrikce Starlinku na Ukrajině, zatímco bankovní sektor zatěžují masivní regulační pokuty.
archive.security_status_en: US markets and the political landscape are rattled by a sharp tech sector sell-off triggered by China's DeepSeek model and rising geopolitical tensions surrounding trade deals and the Middle East conflict. The Trump administration is facing internal dissent over controversial moves like the Russian diesel deal and Starlink restrictions in Ukraine, while the banking sector is burdened by massive regulatory fines.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující volatilitu, jelikož trhy budou vstřebávat dopady čínského technologického šoku a politické napětí kolem zahraniční politiky USA.
archive.forecast_en: Continued volatility can be expected over the coming days as markets absorb the impacts of the Chinese tech shock and political tensions surrounding US foreign policy.

archive.security_status_cs: Spojené státy čelí silnému ekonomickému tlaku v důsledku inflačního oživení (CPI vzrostl na 3,7 %) a prudkého propadu technologických akcií vyvolaného čínským modelem DeepSeek. Politická scéna je napjatá kvůli blížícím se midterms, právním sporům Bílé domu ohledně přístupu médií a vyšetřování kongresmanky Ilhan Omar.
archive.security_status_en: The United States is facing intense economic pressure due to a rebound in inflation (CPI rising to 3.7%) and a steep plunge in tech stocks sparked by China's DeepSeek model. The political scene is strained ahead of the midterms, alongside White House legal disputes over media access and a federal inquiry into Rep. Ilhan Omar.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující nervozitu na trzích, neboť investoři přehodnocují valuace technologických firem a reagují na zhoršující se inflační data.
archive.forecast_en: Continued market nervousness can be expected over the coming days as investors reassess tech valuations and respond to worsening inflation data.

archive.security_status_cs: Americká ekonomika čelí prudkému výprodeji v technologickém sektoru kvůli obavám z inflace a vysokého zadlužení spojeného s umělou inteligencí, přičemž inflace v září vzrostla na 3,7 %. Politické napětí roste v souvislosti s blížícími se midterm volbami a spory kolem administrativy prezidenta Trumpa, migrace a zahraniční politiky.
archive.security_status_en: The US economy is facing a sharp tech sector sell-off driven by inflation fears and AI debt concerns, with September inflation rising to 3.7%. Political tensions are mounting ahead of the midterm elections alongside controversies surrounding President Trump's administration, immigration, and foreign policy.
